requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single constraint requirement based on the scope limitation ('shall be equipped').

source_fragments: All medium-sized vehicles shall be equipped with a navigation system.
structured_requirements.final_statement: All medium-sized vehicles shall be equipped with a navigation system.
structuring_notes: The use of 'shall be equipped' mandates a design choice/specification, classifying this as a constraint rather than a dynamic functional behavior.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not specify the required functionality or standard of the navigation system, as this was not provided in the text or context.
